speech:
Team, I've got good news and I've got homework.

Here's the scorecard: 6 games, 3 wins, 0 draws, 3 losses. Goals: 13 for, 14 against.

Remember the 4-1 against Real Munch? Bottle that and drink it daily. That 1-4 against LavaCakesFc stung. Stings are reminders, not definitions. When we kept it simple, we cooked. When we got fancy, we burned the toast.

We played well in patches, like a quilt with a few squares missing.

buddskees, 3 goals, 1 assist, 5 key passes across 6 games and an 8.0 average. That's the kind of day that makes a coach misty. tuxedo_slide: 1 goal, 1 key pass, 7.8 average. You were the steady heartbeat of this team today. And PhogsToffees, 2 goals, 4 assists, 7 key passes and a 7.3 average over 6 games. Don't you dare let anybody tell you that didn't matter. BellyTb1, 2 goals, 2 assists, 3 key passes across 6 games and a 7.0 average. That's the kind of day that makes a coach misty.

5 goals came from PhogsToffees and buddskees working together. That's the model.

A good pie needs time in the oven. Pull it too early and it's soup. We're still baking.

The thing that'll move the needle most is defensive work rate. Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.

The league table says We're in Division 3 with 9 of 12 points and 1 of 3 chances left. Here we go.

Effort was solid. Execution needs a polish.

Let's turn 'almost' into 'absolutely.'

A sculptor once said the statue's already in the rock; you just chip away the extra. We're chipping.

It wasn't a bad day, and it wasn't a great one. It was a 'we're figuring it out' day, and I'll take a figuring-it-out day over a giving-up day every single time.

I like this group. I like our chances.

Rest those legs and those heads. Big things ahead.
